acquisition method: The top 20 intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation in the HCD cell
alkylation reagent: protein was treated for a sequential of 5 mM DTT (DL-Dithiothreitol) reduction, 20 mM IAA (indole-3-acetic acid) alkylation
cleavage agent: The treated proteins were digested on the 30 kDa filter unit (Millipore, Darmstadt, Germany) over night with trypsin at pH = 8.0 (enzyme:protein = 1:50).
collision energy: The top 20 intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation in the HCD cell at normalized collision energy of 27%
enrichment method: Subsequently, peptides were incubated with TiO2 beads (GL sciences, Tokyo, Japan) with a ratio of peptide:TiO2 = 1:4
fragmentation method: The top 20 intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation in the HCD cell
instrument: LC-MS/MS analyses were performed on an Easy-nLC 1000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo, Waltham, WA, USA) coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus
ionization type: coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus via a nano-electrospray ion source (Thermo).
labeling: By employing a label-free; MS (Mass Spectrometry)-based phosphoproteomic approach; we identified 2271 phosphosites
reduction reagent: protein was treated for a sequential of 5 mM DTT (DL-Dithiothreitol) reduction
reduction concentration: protein was treated for a sequential of 5 mM DTT (DL-Dithiothreitol) reduction
